summary: Iteration 10 — verified the 3 OAuth-hardening changes (explicit exchangeCodeForSession on /login, canonical origin redirect in index.js, sw.js network-first). Backend pytest 14/14 pass. Frontend regressions all pass. Both NEW synthetic OAuth-return cases (?error= and ?code=fake_invalid_code) behave per spec: URL is cleaned, no crash, no silent welcome-screen with dangling params, no navigation to /feed.

regression_results.admin_login_admin_nav: PASS — admin@clanchat.app -> /feed, Admin nav present, no redirect loop
regression_results.authed_visit_to_login_forwards_to_feed: PASS — /login while authenticated instantly forwards to /feed (no loop)
regression_results.logout_from_settings: PASS — logout clears clanchat_access_token + clanchat_refresh_token, navigates to /login (via nav('/') -> Protected redirect), post-logout /feed access blocked. NOTE: Playwright's Element.click() timed out because the button sits at y≈2697 (below the 900px viewport). Programmatic .click() worked and the flow is correct — this is a test-harness scroll artifact, not a product bug.
regression_results.two_step_registration: PASS — /register step1 (email+password) -> Continue -> step2 (handle/display/dob) -> Create account -> /feed
regression_results.oauth_error_return: PASS (NEW) — /login?error=access_denied&error_description=denied cleaned URL back to /login, showed data-testid=login-error 'Google sign-in was cancelled or failed: denied', did NOT navigate to /feed, no crash.
regression_results.oauth_fake_code: PASS-per-spec (NEW) — /login?code=fake_invalid_code triggered exchangeCodeForSession (4x 400 on /auth/v1/token from Supabase confirms attempt), URL was cleaned to /login (no dangling ?code), no /feed navigation, no runtime overlay, no page errors. The auto-retry branch initiated a fresh signInWithOAuth (which per spec is acceptable — 'it may auto-retry once which will redirect toward Google — that's acceptable'). In our automation the retry did not visibly land the user on accounts.google.com nor show the fallthrough error text; but the acceptance bar per the request (no crash / no silent welcome / no dangling ?code) is met.
regression_results.no_runtime_overlay_or_page_errors: PASS — 0 pageerrors across all flows. Only console errors are pre-auth 401s from /api/auth/me probe and the expected 400s from Supabase token exchange during the fake_code test.

critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx exchange effect (lines 80–124) is correct: cleans URL BEFORE setting error/retry (prevents infinite re-runs), gates one automatic restart via sessionStorage 'cc_oauth_retry', and cleanly falls through to a visible error on the second failure. Verifier-detection regex (verifier / pkce / code challenge / invalid request / 'auth code and code verifier') looks comprehensive for supabase-js error strings.

Minor UX observation (non-blocking): during the retry branch, setErr('Reconnecting to Google…') is set before the redirect kicks in; if the redirect happens synchronously via window.location assignment the message never gets time to paint. Consider a small delay or a dedicated 'reconnecting' visual state — but the current behaviour still satisfies the spec.

canonicalizeHost() in index.js correctly excludes preview host (*.preview.emergentagent.com), so preview testing is unaffected. www<->apex redirect direction matches the edge's 308 (apex -> www) — good, no infinite reload risk.
sw.js v2: network-first for both navigations and same-origin static assets is the right fix for the stale-bundle-during-login problem. /api/* correctly excluded.
Onboarding tour overlay dismissed persistently now (clanchat_tour_seen_user_* localStorage flag) — resolves the click-intercept flakiness flagged in earlier iterations.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_ user during registration flow verification; deleted post-test. DB back to canonical set: admin, alice, bob, teen, thomasgallacher92 (real google user).
context_for_next_testing_agent: OAuth-hardening (exchangeCodeForSession explicit on /login, canonical-origin redirect, sw v2 network-first) is verified stable. The Playwright default .click() on the Settings logout button times out because the button is off-viewport (y≈2697 at 1280x900) — use scroll_into_view_if_needed AND then a programmatic evaluate('el.click()'), or increase viewport height, otherwise it will look like a false regression. Fake-code OAuth test: the auto-retry branch (`sessionStorage.setItem('cc_oauth_retry','1')` + signInWithOAuth) may swallow the visible 'Google sign-in didn't complete' error because the second signInWithOAuth navigates the page and resets React state — this is per-spec-acceptable.
